facts.label: Test functions
facts.note: Counted by grep. Parametrised cases make the collected total higher — see tests_passing.

facts.label: Tests passing
facts.note: Observed 2026-08-14 on Python 3.12.13. The suite takes about two minutes, so it was run in ten chunks whose totals sum to exactly the 1,596 that --collect-only reports — that is what makes the coverage complete rather than merely large. The repository's prose says 1,593 passed; the measured split has five more skips.

facts.label: Live model calls in the default test run
facts.note: pytest.ini pins addopts to -m "not live". Reaching a real provider requires opting in with the `live` marker, so the default run cannot touch one.
